title: Iterated cones impose affine support
statement: Let X=\operatorname{Spec}(A) be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], let g_1,\dots,g_s\in A, put T=V(g_1,\dots,g_s), and let E be a perfect object of D(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex]. Put C_0=E and, for 1\le i\le s, let C_i be a cone of multiplication by g_i on C_{i-1}. Then C_s is perfect and its cohomology sheaves vanish on X\setminus T. If moreover U\subset X is a quasi-compact open, F is a perfect object of D(\mathcal O_U) with E|_U\cong F\oplus F[1], and multiplication by each g_i is zero on F, then C_s|_U\cong\bigoplus_{j=0}^{s+1}F[j]^{\oplus\binom{s+1}{j}}.
